notes.title: Boss RE-Patch
notes.notes:
Boss Updates
Fixed the boss HP bar display issue.
Added a death animation for the boss.

New Features:
Introduced a new end screen for a polished conclusion.

Bug Fixes:
Resolved minor bugs to enhance gameplay experience.

notes.title: Boss health PATCH
notes.notes:
Adjusted Boss Health: Scales dynamically based on the number of players.

Added Garage Signs: Helpful signs placed in garages for better navigation.

Seasonal Update: Removed Christmas decorations and content.

New Feature: Introduced the "Hall of Sigmas."

notes.title: Multiplayer Patch 1.1
notes.notes:
Co-op Changes:

Addressed issues with 1-5 player co-op. The mode has temporarily been reformatted to support 1-4 players.
A fix for 1-5 player co-op will be implemented at a later date.
New Features:

Added a guide drawing to the first level to improve player navigation.
